title: Golden Gate Bridge Ka Paint Secret! 🌉 #shorts
idea: The Golden Gate Bridge is continuously painted to protect it against corrosion, using about 10,000 gallons of paint every year.

lines.text: Golden Gate Bridge ko bachane ke liye har saal paint hota hai!
Kya aapko pata hai ki isme kitna paint lagta hai?
Yeh paint corrosion se bachane ke liye continuous kiya jata hai.
San Francisco ka yeh iconic bridge duniya bhar mein famous hai.
Iska main span 4,200 feet lamba hai!
Socho, itna bada bridge maintain karna kitna mushkil hoga?

youtube.title: Golden Gate Bridge Ko Har Saal 10,000 Gallons Paint Kyun Lagta Hai? 🌉 #shorts
youtube.description:
Jaaniye Golden Gate Bridge ke baare mein ek hairatangez sach! Yeh bridge corrosion se bachne ke liye har saal lagbhag 10,000 gallons paint use karta hai.

#GoldenGateBridge #AmazingFacts #HinglishShorts #BridgeFacts #Knowledge

facts.claim: The bridge uses approximately 10,000 gallons of paint annually.
